evidence: We anticipate that AI technologies may become increasingly integrated into our operations over time.
AI use cases are subject to ongoing governance, risk assessment, and appropriate oversight to maintain compliance with applicable laws, ethical standards, and organizational policies.
Our governance framework requires that AI-enabled processes remain explainable and auditable, supported by controls designed to manage outcomes and escalate issues when necessary.
We are also exposed to risks arising from the use of AI by threat actors to commit fraud, misappropriate funds, and facilitate cyberattacks.
ai_positioning.summary: Zions adopte progressivement l'IA en interne avec un cadre de gouvernance strict, tout en reconnaissant les risques significatifs liés aux hallucinations, biais et menaces cybernétiques.
